Without access to platforms like Stripe or PayPal, the challenge becomes finding a reliable infrastructure that supports crypto payments and offers ownership. COREMERCH provides two distinct stacks, each catering to the unique needs of digital creators. This analysis compares Stack 01 and Stack 02, focusing on deployment speed, ease of use, and cost-effectiveness to help you make an informed decision.
What Each Option Actually Offers

Stack 01 utilizes GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, allowing for rapid deployment in 4-6 hours following the Sovereign Blueprint. This stack is straightforward, appealing to those comfortable with basic coding and GitHub. Conversely, Stack 02 leverages Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase, providing a more robust infrastructure. Deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours, Stack 02 delivers a complete solution that includes five products pre-loaded, with advanced configuration such as SPF/DKIM/DMARC. This makes Stack 02 a better choice for creators looking for more comprehensive features and automated functionalities.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Both Stack 01 and Stack 02 are designed with the needs of creators in restricted countries in mind. Stack 01 is ideal for those who want to start quickly and are experienced with GitHub but may require more manual setup for backend functionality. Stack 02 provides a ready-made solution that is fully tested and operational, minimizing deployment risks. The integration of NOWPayments in both stacks ensures that users can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, making it easier for creators in regions where traditional payment methods are unavailable to monetize their digital products.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When it comes to payment processing, both stacks utilize NOWPayments, which offers a 0.5% fee and supports low-cost networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON. Stack 01 enables creators to manage payment processes independently, but the manual setup may lead to delays in transactions. In contrast, Stack 02’s automated workflow via Cloudflare Workers ensures that payments are processed swiftly, allowing creators to focus on their products rather than payment logistics. The real cost of both stacks remains low, but the added automation in Stack 02 provides significant time savings that could translate to better revenue generation.
Choose Stack 02 for advanced automation and faster deployment.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership is a critical factor for creators, and both stacks offer full ownership of the deployed infrastructure. However, Stack 02 stands out with its automation capabilities, providing a seamless customer experience from payment confirmation to product delivery. Stack 01 requires more manual intervention for product delivery, which may be a hurdle for some creators. With Stack 02, creators benefit from an end-to-end tested environment that not only ensures immediate file delivery upon payment confirmation but also minimizes the risk of operational hiccups, allowing for a more professional storefront.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing between Stack 01 and Stack 02 depends on your technical expertise and requirements. If you are comfortable with coding and are looking for a quick setup without extensive features, Stack 01 may suffice. However, if you prefer a comprehensive solution with advanced automation, faster deployment, and guaranteed support, Stack 02 is the better option. It is important to evaluate your long-term goals and whether you anticipate scaling your operation, as Stack 02 offers more room for growth without the need for significant reconfiguration.

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, consider using COREMERCH's Stack 01 or Stack 02. Stack 01 can be deployed in about 4-6 hours with basic coding skills, while Stack 02 offers a more automated, feature-rich solution deployed within 48 hours, suitable for creators looking for a robust setup without technical hassles.
Stack 01 is ideal for quick setups if you have coding skills.

The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything to build Stack 01 yourself in an afternoon or Stack 02 over a weekend — full source code, step-by-step configuration, and the NOWPayments integration guide. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH build Stack 02 for you in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC configured for email deliverability. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. Both are at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Start by selecting your preferred stack based on your technical skills. Next, configure your backend using GitHub Pages for Stack 01 or Cloudflare Pages for Stack 02. After that, set up NOWPayments to accept cryptocurrency. Proceed to upload your digital products and configure delivery settings. Finally, test the entire process to ensure everything functions as expected before promoting your store.
